dek: The Government announced today (August 14) the reappointment of Mr Clement Cheung Wan-ching as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Insurance Authority (IA) for a term of three years from August 15, 2026, to August 14, 2029. The appointment was approved by the Chief Executive under the Insurance Ordinance (Cap. 41)
